vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Gianna was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Sanne taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Hank showed Jae the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Sanne showed Tom the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
🛡️ Gianna, Andre, Devon and Tom met them at the door — 4 put down. Gianna, Andre, Devon, Tom are hurt.

Theo has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Sanne is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
🛡️ Ryan, Omelyan, Andre and Devon met them at the door — 3 put down. Omelyan didn't come back. Ryan, Andre, Devon are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Sweeps Week (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Liam. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
You fling a handful of grit into The Pack-leader Sweeps Week's eyes. It reels, clawing at its face — half-blind for 2 rounds. (Pocket Sand: attacks at disadvantage.)
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Theo, Devon and Tom met them at the door — 3 put down. Theo, Devon, Tom are hurt.

regDeaths.name: two knobs on glass-still water, watching
